goals: Upgrade the Calling All Angels precon to upper bracket 3. Mono-white Angel tribal: Giada makes every Angel enter bigger and ramps into Angels; win through the air with a board of evasive, growing Angels backed by anthems and lifegain payoffs.
meta: 4-player casual pods. The same 3 opponents rotate between 10+ different decks game to game, so cards are judged on general usefulness across unknown decks -- NOT tuned against specific opponents. Do not carry forward any fixed description of what the pod plays. Pod tendency reported by the user 2026-10-02: the majority of wins come through ground (non-flying) attacks.
constraints: No early infinite combos. Late-game infinite lines are fine -- the test is speed and tutor-dependence, not the presence of a loop.
No win line that depends on tutoring to assemble.
Total upgrade spend about $300; no single card over $40.
preferences: Prefer on-theme Angel cards, but a strong off-theme card is acceptable.
